Complete initialized native i32/i64 carrier is copied before transforms and little-endian piece slicing. Float/uncaptured/global/operand/unresolved transforms are explicit holes beside independent known fragments.

Original C/C++/Objective-C/Objective-C++ Wasm32/64 DWARF4/5 O0/O1 aggregate has low165/high90/enabled true or false/narrowed-128. Guest self checks and original validator/DWARF verify pass without binary rewriting.
